openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Wi-Fi 6 (AX3000) router built around the MediaTek MT7981 (Filogic 820, 64-bit dual-core Cortex-A53, 1.3 GHz per Cudy's spec), with 1x2.5 Gb WAN (PoE-in) + 4x1 Gb LAN, a USB 2.0 port, and 4 non-detachable antennas. Closely related to the Cudy WR3000H: differences are 512 MB RAM (2x the H), a USB 2.0 port, and 802.3af/at PoE-in on the 2.5 Gb WAN port.
openwrt_wiki.flash_wechsel: Cudy shipped an undisclosed SPI-NAND change without bumping the version: newer units use a newer ESMT F50L1G41-family flash that older OpenWrt or older Cudy intermediate images cannot boot. Not reliably identifiable from the serial number; use OpenWrt 24.10.5 or newer and a current Cudy intermediate image (post-November-2025 build). dmesg reports the ESMT part family.
openwrt_wiki.backup: Per-unit partitions Factory (Wi-Fi calibration, mtd2) and bdinfo (MACs, mtd3) are in no download; sysupgrade only rewrites ubi; capture them before any ubootmod conversion.
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem: Cudy-signed OpenWrt intermediate image (WR3000P 1.0.zip, Cudy OpenWrt Software Download page / Google Drive) via OEM web UI at http://192.168.10.1, then official sysupgrade from LuCI (192.168.1.1) without keeping settings.
openwrt_wiki.installation_seriell: Stub. Serial + TFTP possible per PR #19636 (UART 115200 8N1, 3.3 V; U-Boot tftpboot initramfs, then sysupgrade). Solder-pad locations / pinout not documented.
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout_bemerkung: OEM layout leaves ~44 MB usable overlay. Optional ubootmod layout (25.12 series, PR #22625): ubi grows to ~122 MB (~95 MB usable overlay, derived estimate), mainline U-Boot with TFTP/web recovery; bad BL2 needs serial/hardware recovery.
openwrt_wiki.leds: 10 indicators: System, Internet, 2.4G, 5G, USB = SoC GPIO (pio 11/6/7/9/4); LAN1-LAN4 = MT7531 switch hardware; WAN = Realtek RTL8221B PHY LED1 (not SoC GPIO).
openwrt_wiki.wan_led: WAN LED does not light on fresh OpenWrt install (DTS led-wan pio 5 inherited from WR3000 drives nothing); rtl822x PHY-LED support only from Linux 7.2 (d3aae4d954f9); userspace workaround with mdio-tools.
openwrt_wiki.recovery: Soft-brick: Cudy generic TFTP recovery guide with WR3000P OEM image. Hard-brick: OEM TFTP install path from support commit (U-Boot shell, tftpboot). Not tested by page author.
openwrt_wiki.notes_poe: PoE-in (802.3af/at, 48-57 V, 18 W) on the WAN port - powered-device only. Untested under OpenWrt at time of writing.
openwrt_wiki.notes_usb: Cudy specs USB 2.0, usable speed USB 2.0; MT7981 xHCI reports USB 3.x capability in dmesg, but that is the SoC controller, not the port wiring.
openwrt_wiki.notes_sku: _EU / _US suffix is retail SKU / packaging distinction; same OpenWrt profile cudy_wr3000p-v1 and same Cudy image. Only _EU units on hand; _US equivalence inferred.
openwrt_wiki.typenschild_format: Management http://192.168.10.1 (or http://cudy.net). Power: 12 V / 1.5 A, or PoE-in 802.3af/at 48-57 V, 18 W. Default SSID Cudy-XXXX / Cudy-XXXX-5G (last four hex digits of MAC). MAC OUI D4:0D:AB; label MAC = LAN/base, WAN = base + 1. Serial number appears to encode YYWW (S00071812611... = 2026 week 11, inferred). Default Wi-Fi password: 8-digit numeric, per unit.
